## Category 1: Types & Mock Data (4 tests)

### UAT-1.1: Types file exists with Position types
**Given:** P97 implementation started
**Then:** `src/app/types/stories.ts` exists with `PositionType`, `POSITION_VALUES`, `Story`, `Point`, `Position`, `UserCalibration` types
**Verify:** `npm run build` compiles without errors

### UAT-1.2: Mock data file exists
**Given:** Types are defined
**Then:** `src/app/data/mock-stories.ts` exists with sample stories, points, positions, and calibration data
**Verify:** File exists and exports `mockStories`, `mockPoints`, `mockPositions`, `mockCalibration`

### UAT-1.3: Position values map correctly
**Given:** `POSITION_VALUES` constant exists
**Then:** Maps 7-point Likert scale: strongly_disagree=-3, disagree=-2, somewhat_disagree=-1, unsure=0, somewhat_agree=1, agree=2, strongly_agree=3
**Verify:** Unit test in `src/tests/types/stories.test.ts`

### UAT-1.4: Story interface includes visibility and eventId
**Given:** Story type defined
**Then:** Story has `visibility: 'public' | 'shared' | 'private'` and optional `eventId?: string`
**Verify:** TypeScript compilation

## Category 4: Profile Page (6 tests)

### UAT-4.1: Profile page shows CalibrationDisplay
**Given:** User views profile at `/p/:slug`
**Then:** CalibrationDisplay renders below profile card with listener/speaker metrics
**Verify:** Playwright MCP screenshot

### UAT-4.2: Profile page shows ContentTabs
**Given:** User views profile at `/p/:slug`
**Then:** Stories/Points tabs appear and switch content correctly
**Verify:** Playwright MCP click tabs + screenshot

### UAT-4.3: Profile works for any user (own vs other)
**Given:** User views own profile vs another user's profile
**Then:** Same `/p/:slug` route works; `isOwnProfile` controls what's editable
**Verify:** Playwright MCP — view own profile, view other's profile

### UAT-4.4: BrainDump composer shows on own profile only
**Given:** User views own profile
**Then:** BrainDump composer stub appears
**When:** User views other's profile
**Then:** BrainDump composer is hidden
**Verify:** Playwright MCP — check presence on own, absence on other's

### UAT-4.5: Credibility stats show in profile card
**Given:** Profile page rendered
**Then:** Ear/Mic credibility counts display with tooltips
**Verify:** Playwright MCP screenshot + hover tooltip

### UAT-4.6: Position buttons work on profile
**Given:** User views Points tab on any profile
**When:** User clicks Agree/Disagree/Unsure button
**Then:** Position updates immediately (optimistic UI)
**Verify:** Playwright MCP click + verify button state change

## Category 6: Mobile/Responsive (5 tests)

### UAT-6.1: Single breakpoint at 1024px
**Given:** All responsive components
**Then:** `lg:` breakpoint (1024px) used consistently — mobile below, desktop at/above
**Verify:** Code review — grep for breakpoint usage

**Given:** Mobile viewport (<1024px)
**Then:** All interactive elements (buttons, menu items, tooltip triggers) have min 44x44px touch area

**Then:** Bottom nav includes `pb-[env(safe-area-inset-bottom)]` for iOS notch

**When:** User taps tooltip trigger

**Verify:** Playwright MCP screenshot at 375px

## Success Criteria

1. All 38 UAT tests show ✅
2. `./scripts/pre-commit-checks.sh` passes
3. No console errors during Playwright verification

Output `<promise>P97 UAT COMPLETE</promise>` when done.

## Notes for Agent

- **Use Playwright MCP** for visual verification
- **Use Chrome DevTools MCP** if network issues
- **Commit after each category passes** — Progress is preserved
- **Update scorecard** after each test — This file is your state
- **TDD required** — Write failing test first, then implement
- **Mock data only** — No database calls in P97; components receive props
- **Reuse existing components** — Check `src/components/ui/` before creating new ones
